name: VRM_PO_ASSET_LIAB_NETTING
description: This table contains the netting details  of the Contract Asset and Contract Liability accounts for performance obligations for each period.

columns.name: PO_ASSET_LIAB_NETTING_ID
columns.description: Contract asset and liability netting details table unique identifier.

columns.name: CUSTOMER_CONTRACT_HEADER_ID
columns.description: Number that identifies the customer contract header.

columns.name: PERF_OBLIGATION_ID
columns.description: Number that identifies the performance obligation.

columns.name: CURRENCY_CODE
columns.description: Transaction currency code of the contract.

columns.name: ALLOCATION_METHOD_CODE
columns.description: Allocation currency basis used to allocate and recognize revenue for a contract. Valid values are from the lookup type ORA_VRM_ALLOCATION_METHOD.

columns.name: CONTRACT_ASSET_AMT_ENT_CURR
columns.description: Total contract asset amount of the performance obligation in the entered currency.

columns.name: CONTRACT_ASSET_AMT_ACCTD_CURR
columns.description: Total contract asset amount of the performance obligation in the accounted currency.

columns.name: CONTRACT_LIAB_AMT_ENTERED_CURR
columns.description: Total contract liability amount of the performance obligation in the entered currency.

columns.name: CONTRACT_LIAB_AMT_ACCTD_CURR
columns.description: Total contract liability amount of the performance obligation in the accounted currency.

columns.name: CONTRACT_DISC_AMT_ENTERED_CURR
columns.description: Total contract discount amount of the performance obligation in the entered currency.

columns.name: CONTRACT_DISC_AMT_ACCTD_CURR
columns.description: Total contract discount amount of the performance obligation in the accounted currency.

columns.name: NET_POSITION_AMT_ENTERED_CURR
columns.description: Net position of the performance obligation in the entered currency.

columns.name: NET_POSITION_AMT_ACCTD_CURR
columns.description: Net position of the performance obligation in the accounted currency.

columns.name: CAL_CONTRACT_ASSET_AMT_ENT_CUR
columns.description: Total contract asset amount of the performance obligation converted into the entered currency using the period end conversion rate. This amount is calculated for foreign currency contracts where the allocation currency basis is Accounted.

columns.name: CAL_CONTRACT_ASSET_AMT_ACC_CUR
columns.description: Total contract asset amount of the performance obligation converted into the accounted currency using the period end conversion rate. This amount is calculated for foreign currency contracts where the allocation currency basis is Entered.

columns.name: CAL_CONTRACT_LIAB_AMT_ENT_CUR
columns.description: Total contract liability amount of the performance obligation converted into the entered currency using the period end conversion rate. This amount is calculated for foreign currency contracts where the allocation currency basis is Accounted.

columns.name: CAL_CONTRACT_LIAB_AMT_ACC_CUR
columns.description: Total contract liability amount of the performance obligation converted into the accounted currency using the period end conversion rate. This amount is calculated for foreign currency contracts where the allocation currency basis is Entered.

columns.name: CAL_CONTRACT_DISC_AMT_ENT_CUR
columns.description: Total contract discount amount of the performance obligation converted into the entered currency using the period end conversion rate. This amount is calculated for foreign currency contracts where the allocation currency basis is Accounted.

columns.name: CAL_CONTRACT_DISC_AMT_ACC_CUR
columns.description: Total contract discount amount of the performance obligation converted into the accounted currency using the period end conversion rate. This amount is calculated for foreign currency contracts where the allocation currency basis is Entered.

columns.name: CALC_NET_POSITION_ENTERED_CUR
columns.description: Net position of the performance obligation converted into the entered currency using the period end conversion rate. This amount is calculated for foreign currency contracts where the allocation currency basis is Accounted.

columns.name: CALC_NET_POSITION_ACCTD_CUR
columns.description: Net position of the performance obligation converted into the accounted currency using the period end conversion rate. This amount is calculated for foreign currency contracts where the allocation currency basis is Entered.

columns.name: LEDGER_ID
columns.description: Number that identifies the ledger of the contract.

columns.name: EVENT_ID
columns.description: Number that identifies the subledger accounting event.

columns.name: ACCOUNTING_DATE
columns.description: Accounting date of the netting entry.

columns.name: EXECUTION_MODE_CODE
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: DISTRIBUTIONS_CREATED_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether the performance obligation netting distributions are created.

columns.name: LATEST_RECORD_FLAG
columns.description: Latest record for the given ledger, contract, and performance obligation.

columns.name: EXCHANGE_RATE
columns.description: Conversion rate for converting amounts from the obligation currency to the ledger currency.

columns.name: EXCHANGE_RATE_TYPE
columns.description: Conversion rate type used for converting amounts from the entered currency to the ledger currency.

columns.name: PERIOD_NAME
columns.description: Fiscal period a company uses to report financial results, such as a calendar month or fiscal period. Accounting periods make up an accounting calendar.

columns.name: LEDGER_CURRENCY
columns.description: Functional currency of the ledger.

columns.name: POSTING_CONTROL_ID
columns.description: Posting batch identifier. -3 Indicates unposted distributions.

columns.name: POSTED_TO_SLA_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates if a revenue line is posted to subledger application.

columns.name: POSTED_TO_SLA_DATE
columns.description: Date when the revenue is posted to the subledger application.
